messages:
Maria (PM): Quick sync — thinking about a small but targeted reward scheme for design partners to improve feedback quality. Proposal: $100 account credit + priority support for active DP feedback (>=3 substantive reports / month). Also suggest weekly short surveys + one recorded 30m session per month. What do folks think?
Aj (Eng): Sounds reasonable. Two quick asks: we need instrumentation to measure 'substantive' (event schema) and a budget cap per cohort. Also will need a way to auto-apply credits.
Kevin (Design): Agree on credit + priority support. For the weekly surveys, can we make them <5 questions and mostly multiple choice? Open text should be optional but encouraged. If we gate the credit on 3 reports, we should make the reporting flow low-friction — inline in the app or via a short modal.
Sarah (Research): My concern: gating on volume may bias toward low-quality micro-reports. Can we define 'substantive' as 1) a template filled with context + repro steps OR 2) a flagged session with annotated transcript? We can sample and score. Suggest Bi-weekly vs weekly to reduce noise, but keep a weekly micro-check-in message (1 q).
Beth (Ops): Heads up on the $100 credit flow — finance needs a mapping (user_id -> credit code) and an audit trail. Private customers may not accept credits; may need to exchange for extended SLA or training hours. Also, legal wants a privacy addendum for recorded 30m sessions.
Aj (Eng): For instrumentation, propose event names: `dp.feedback.submission`, `dp.feedback.quality_score`, `dp.session.recorded`. Quality scoring pipeline could be simple for v1: heuristics (length, template fields filled, attachments) and then a manual sample for calibration. I can sketch the telemetry events this week.
Kevin (Design): +1 to short modal. I'll prototype a 3-step modal: quick context, what went wrong, severity tag. Also UX for credit status: show progress (1/3) and expected reward.
Maria (PM): Good points. Draft acceptance criteria for the pilot: 1) Recruit 20 DP customers, 2) Achieve >=60% monthly active feedback participation, 3) Collect 80 usable bug/quality reports in 8 weeks, 4) No legal block on recorded sessions. If we hit these, consider rolling to next 100 customers.
Sarah (Research): Suggest success metrics we can track: avg time-to-first-feedback after invite, % of submissions passing manual quality check, NPS delta for participants vs control. We should also capture qualitative themes for product roadmap decisions.
Beth (Ops): I'll confirm finance process and get a template credit code flow. Also looping Legal to create a short DP consent addendum.
Maria (PM): Next steps: Aj sketch telemetry + infra tickets by Thu; Kevin to prototype modal and progress UI by Fri; Sarah to draft sampling rubric; Beth to confirm credit logistics & legal path. I'll draft an invite email + onboarding checklist for the DP cohort. Meeting next Wednesday to finalize. :thumbsup: 
onboarding-bot: Maria scheduled follow-up: DP-program-sync on Wed 10:00.
